name: Equinox Null
description: Equinox Null is a world defined by absence. Its near-zero axial tilt produces a perpetual equinox condition, and its surface is so featureless that early surveys initially classified it as a calibration error. Featureless basalt plains extend in every direction, their surfaces smoothed by billions of years of micrometeorite bombardment into a uniformly grey, slightly glossy finish. A single massive impact basin on the southern hemisphere provides the only significant topographic variation.

The airless surface reflects a uniform grey in all directions, creating a disorienting sense of standing on a sphere without landmarks. Navigation without instruments is effectively impossible, as every direction looks identical. The temperature differential between the sunlit and shadowed hemispheres is the only way to establish orientation without electronic assistance. The silence is total and oppressive, a void of sensory input that affects crew psychology on extended surface operations.

Equinox Null's extraordinary featurelessness has itself become a subject of scientific inquiry. The micrometeorite smoothing explains the surface texture, but the absence of craters, ridges, or any other geological features beyond the single impact basin suggests a geological history of remarkable uniformity. Some models propose the planet was resurfaced by a global lava flood relatively recently in geological terms, erasing all prior features before the surface solidified into its current basalt plain.

The planet's primary utility is as a navigational reference point and emergency waystation, its predictable surface and lack of hazards making it a safe landing site for vessels in distress. A small automated beacon maintains a position near the impact basin, the only artificial structure on a world that seems to resist the imposition of features. Mining surveys have found iron and silicon in adequate but uninspiring quantities, insufficient to justify dedicated extraction operations.
